msg: I had no plan really, but I started counting to six. If the gnomes appeared on 'one' and the basket appeared on 'three' then I pressed a letter on 'one' and the space bar on 'three'. This was to avoid being too slow and so, not receiving any mushrooms at all. I noticed, but might be wrong(!) that the numbers of mushrooms may have been slightly higher if I clicked the gnome on the right using key S, but I'm not sure about that. Towards the end of the experiment I stopped pressing 'K' and consistently pressed 'S' and then Space.
